spotlight.title: MoxRiding
spotlight.description: MoxRiding turns skateboarding into a fast-paced game of skill, timing, and strategy! Chain tricks into massive combos, then carefully roll straight to bank your points before risking it all on another trick. With a global TOP 10 leaderboard, every run is a chance to make skateboarding history. Easy to learn, challenging to master, and endlessly replayable!

spotlight.title: Paintballz.io
spotlight.description:
Paintballz.io is a fast online multiplayer paintball shooter. One paintball is all it takes: there are no health bars, so whoever lands the first hit wins the fight. Paintballs fly as real projectiles that drop over distance, so lead your targets, use cover and outplay the other side.

Jump into a room with up to 18 players and play Team Deathmatch (Blue against Red) or Free for All. Rooms are never empty: bots fill the free spots, and every player who joins takes a bot's place. When a round ends, everyone votes on the next map and the fun keeps going.

Features:
- One-hit tags with real paintball physics: ball speed, drop, spread and range
- Team Deathmatch and Free for All on 5 maps: Classic, House, Warehouse, Proto Yard and Trenches
- 27 paintguns, from rifles and SMGs to shotguns, miniguns and snipers with scopes, unlocked with the cash you earn by playing
- Kill-streak rewards: Radar, Sentry, Drone, Wall, Tank and Nuke
- Over 100 accessories for your character: hats, masks, backpacks, wings and full outfits
- Daily tasks, daily login rewards and 100 levels to climb
- Play with friends: parties, private rooms and invite links
- Servers around the world: the game picks the closest one, or choose your own
- A quick tutorial for new players, so you can start tagging in under a minute
- Your progress is saved to your CrazyGames account
spotlight.controls:
WASD or arrow keys: move
Mouse: look and aim
Left mouse button: shoot (hold for automatic guns)
Right mouse button (hold) or E: aim / scope
Space: jump (after you're tagged: respawn sooner)
Z, X, C, V: use kill-streak rewards
1: back to your gun
Enter or T: chat
Tab (hold): scoreboard
M: mute
Esc or P: pause
K: skip the tutorial
All keys except Esc can be changed in Settings.

spotlight.title: LongCat
spotlight.description:
LongCat is a relaxing yet tricky puzzle game. Swipe to send your cat sliding across the board and fill every empty tile. The cat keeps sliding until it hits a wall or its own tail, and it can never go back over the path it already covered. Plan your route carefully, because one wrong move can leave you with no way forward.

Every level is different and the boards get bigger and harder as you go. Stuck? Watch a short video to undo your last move, or skip a level you can't beat. Finish a level to earn gems and boost them with a lucky multiplier. Spend your gems in the shop on new cat colors and preview each one live while the cat plays.

Features:
- Simple one-finger swipe controls
- Endless levels that get harder
- Fresh cat colors to unlock
- Revive, skip and double-reward options
- Bright, juicy cartoon style
- Works on mobile and desktop
spotlight.controls:
Mobile: swipe up, down, left or right to move the cat.
Desktop: arrow keys or WASD to move, Esc to pause, R to restart the level.

spotlight.title: Gravity Flip
spotlight.description: Gravity Flip is a fast one-tap runner where you control a cube sliding along the floor and ceiling of a neon corridor. Tap to flip gravity, dodge the walls closing in, and grab coins along the way. The corridor gets faster and trickier with every level, and each level changes the colors of the world. When a run ends, spend your coins in the shop on new cubes and glowing trails, or watch a short video to multiply your coin reward with the bonus meter. Play free in your browser at PlayKovo, no download and no sign-up.
spotlight.controls:
Mobile: tap anywhere on the screen to flip gravity.
Desktop: click, or press Space, Up Arrow, Down Arrow or Enter to flip gravity.

spotlight.title: Pixel Paint
spotlight.description:
Pixel Paint is a relaxing color-by-number game where every pixel hides a number. Pick the matching color, drag your finger across the grid and watch a gray canvas turn into a cute pixel picture.

Start with a simple heart and work your way through 60 hand-made pictures: fruits, animals, sweets, flowers, vehicles and more. Zoom in to reach tiny pixels, zoom out to admire your work, and enjoy the satisfying pop of every painted pixel.

Features:

60 hand-made pixel pictures, with more on the way
Easy one-finger painting, no timers and no pressure
Pinch to zoom and drag to move around the canvas
FIND hint that points you to the next pixel
AUTO fill: a helping hand paints a whole color for you
Collect coins and spend them in the shop
Relaxing music and a satisfying win animation
Your progress is saved automatically

Perfect for a quick break or a long chill session. Can you finish them all?
spotlight.controls:
Mobile: Touch and drag to paint. Two-finger pinch to zoom. Drag on empty or wrong pixels to move the canvas.
PC: Click and drag to paint. Mouse wheel to zoom. Drag on a wrong pixel to move the canvas.
Buttons: The fit button resets the zoom, FIND shows the next pixel, AUTO paints the selected color, and the pause button opens the menu.

spotlight.title: Stack Jump
spotlight.description:
Stack Jump is a one-tap arcade game where you build a tower by jumping onto blocks. Rock blocks slide in from the left and right. Tap at the right moment to jump, and the block stops under your feet. Jump too late and the block knocks you off the tower.

Land a block right in the center to get a PERFECT: +2 points, a star burst and a combo counter. The blocks get faster as your tower grows, and the scenery changes every 15 points, from a starry night to ocean, sunset, aurora and lava skies.

Collect coins after every run and spend them in the shop on 8 character colors and 10 accessories, including a cap, shades, headphones, a top hat, a crown and a halo. Upgrade your coin income, continue a run once by watching an ad, and triple your coins with the x3 claim.

Features:
- Simple one-tap controls
- Perfect landings, combos and increasing speed
- 5 changing sky themes
- 8 characters and 10 accessories to unlock
- Coin income upgrade
- Best score saved automatically
spotlight.controls:
Mobile: Tap anywhere on the screen to jump.
Desktop: Click, or press Space / Arrow Up to jump.

spotlight.title: Hexa Go
spotlight.description: Hexa Go is a satisfying hex puzzle. Every tile has an arrow, and tapping a tile sends it sliding off the board the way its arrow points. Clear a path first: if another tile is in the way, your tile crashes and you lose a heart. Levels start flat and grow into stacked boards two, three and four layers high, with immovable stones and odd-shaped boards to plan around. Turn the board to see every arrow, zoom in for the tricky spots, and use the Hint and Rotate boosters when you get stuck. Rotate lets you turn a single tile's arrow toward a clear way out. Collect gems, unlock new tile styles, and see how far you can go.
spotlight.controls: Mouse / touch: tap a tile to send it. Drag (or swipe in a circle around the board) to turn the board. Mouse wheel / two-finger pinch: zoom. Keyboard: H = hint, T = rotate booster, Q / E = turn the board, R = restart.

spotlight.title: Cube Slide Merge
spotlight.description:
Cube Slide Merge is a number puzzle where every move counts. Swipe in any direction and all the cubes on the board slide together until they hit a wall or another cube. When two cubes with the same number meet, they merge into a single cube with the next number up. Clear the board down to one cube to finish the level.

The boards are never the same. Some are plain rectangles, others are shaped like letters, staircases or boards with holes, so a slide that works in one corner can wreck your plan in another. You cannot move a single cube on its own, which means you have to plan how the whole group will travel before you swipe.

Every level is generated so that it can be solved, and the levels keep going with bigger boards and more cubes as you progress. Finishing a level in few moves earns up to three stars and more coins.

Stuck? Undo your last move as often as you like, or use a hint to see the next swipe. Spend your coins in the shop on new cube color sets and board themes to change how the game looks.
spotlight.controls: Mouse / touch: swipe or drag in the direction you want the cubes to slide. Keyboard: arrow keys or W A S D to slide, Z or Backspace to undo. Use the buttons at the bottom for hint and undo.
